The task is: Sum supplied already-clipped per-example gradient tensors, add independent Gaussian noise with coordinate standard deviation sigma*C, and divide by positive supplied denominator. Empty batches still add noise. For Poisson sampling the caller supplies expected-batch normalization; this numerical core does not establish a privacy guarantee or secure randomness.

The inputs are `clipped`, `clip`, `sigma`, `denominator`, `generator`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
